scope: SECTIONMANAGER repeated group-330 section-entity pointer identity mapping and bounded list validation.

source_context.model: DRW_Section::Manager stores m_sectionCount and m_sectionHandles; parseCode retains manager group-90 count and repeated group-330 handles.
source_context.documented_role: Autodesk's SECTIONMANAGER DXF table defines group 90 as the number of sections and repeated group 330 values as soft-pointer handles to section entities. Group 330 is a soft pointer under Autodesk's group-code reference.

implementation.behavior: Before publishing SECTIONMANAGER bytes, validate a bounded nonnegative section count equal to the retained list size, and resolve every nonzero/non-sentinel list handle. A configured reference resolver supplies the final identity; otherwise source-handle remapping applies. Emit the resolved handles after the AcDbSectionManager subclass marker, leaving common reactor and owner group-330 fields on their separate paths.
implementation.failure_behavior: Zero or NoHandle source/final list values, count/list mismatches, resolver exceptions, and allocation failures refuse before the SECTIONMANAGER record is emitted.
implementation.retry_behavior: The correction control retries on a fresh writer after refusal; failed dxfRW writer state remains sticky.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: explicit source-handle remap fallback for both section pointers
physical record parsing isolates the repeated list from pre-subclass reactor/owner group-330 fields
zero and NoHandle final identities refuse atomically

qualification_limits: No physical producer or independent native consumer was used.
No source-bound proof establishes that all source SECTIONOBJECT records are present or that each target has valid ownership and matching section semantics.
Correct reference identity transport does not close recursive dependencies or qualify whole-document output.
